role: The dispenser GUI container over TileEntityDispenser's 9 slots.

members.name: tileEntityDispenser
members.note: the window's slots 0..8 read and write the tile's own 9 (a dropper's too) through gui_te_slot

members.name: ContainerDispenser
members.note: CONTAINER_DISPENSER: the 9 tile slots in the chest inventory, then the player's main and hotbar; survival.c's gui_open_tile opens it for a dispenser or a dropper

members.name: canInteractWith
members.note: TileEntityDispenser.isUseableByPlayer: the tile at its position is still this one and the player is within 8 (distance squared to the block centre <= 64)

members.name: transferStackInSlot
members.note: the chest body split at 9, plus the count check (nothing moved answers null) and the plain slot's onPickupFromSlot (no state)

notes: Gated by containers2-s42 (a seed-42 jungle temple dispenser's 12 arrows shift-clicked out; a dropper's window takes 2 cobblestone by right clicks). The dispense itself is unreachable with world.conf redstone off.
